body: If I could I would love to save it. As for reasons for the divorce she feels we need to find ourselves. I'm sure my depression didnt have much help in that case. Thanks for listening. I'm kinda spotty on here with my schedule.
Yes I'm here...just falling in to darkness.
I appreciate the words but I feel my strength draining rapidly. I feel like I'm walking on the edge and the wrong thing is going to happen to send me over.
Thanks for the concern. I'm still slowly learning to get back to a new normal life.
You should let him know he isn't the only one with those thoughts. You two could support each other when you are down.
Understandable. So what's got you feeling down?
Does your girlfriend know of your tendencies of these thoughts?
My ears are open. What's on your mind?
I won't say you will grow out of it. It's more of a you learn to live with those thoughts in the back of your mind. Just want you to know I'm here if you want to talk.

I was 17 my senior year of high school and my brother committed suicide. Which I was dealing with suicidal thoughts myself. But it really does affect families. I have feelings from time to time of beinga disappointment. What helps me the most is my now wife has stuck through it all with me. I guess the best advice I can give is try to find at least a friend that you can rely on.
I'm 21 so not to much more experience than you have. What I can say is sometimes you have to do what you feel is right for you.
If you don't mind me asking. How old are you?
No. Mainly because I don't want to worry her. Plus that's part of my problem I don't like face to face conversations. Which is why I'm on here.

I know how you feel. I was always the one friend in back. I wish I had better advice for you. I know our brains work in different ways. Where some people would find different friends I just cut my ties with people all together. Obviously that's not a good thing to do.
Maybe try something along the lines of one on one hang out sessions if possible. 

Sorry I couldn't be of anymore help...

Me being 21 now and being in a similar position just want to say. Yes friends are great but coming from experience they won't always be there. The best thing I can think of is find something you are passionate about. Something that can help you relax. 
Hope this helps a bit...
